lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four visible longitudinal rows. The nodes exhibit a semi-regular spacing, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with the highest concentration of distinct centroids located posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows of blobs, creating a rectangular grid of anchor nodes where the vertical stripes and horizontal alignments meet.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient where the dorsal-facing surface reflects higher light intensity and the ventral-facing surface is in shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-contrast white object (likely a remora) is attached to the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin.
